T-CASE-0.initial: Independent glass/cam geometry and open frames.
T-CASE-0.action: Insert matching glass, align bottoms, close cams, lift frame50 mm and replace; repeat both positions.
T-CASE-0.observable: Bottom offset, gap, cam travel and relative slip.
T-CASE-0.pass_condition: Bottom edge offset<=0.2 mm; spacer gap1.00 +/-0.05 mm B; glass slip<=0.2 mm after lift; cam limits match independent reference; no unintended overlap>0.2 mm.
T-CASE-0.note: Test conditions and tolerances, not manufacturer performance.

T-CASE-1.initial: Both locked frames available; dry gasket geometry.
T-CASE-1.action: Seat each frame, engage lever, release manipulator, disengage and remove.
T-CASE-1.observable: Lever engagement, frame support and sampled bottom contact path.
T-CASE-1.pass_condition: Lever engages spacer plate within0.5 mm of verified seat; frame drift<=0.5 mm and1 deg; bottom seal path gap<=0.1 mm with compression within independent allowed bounds. Unknown compression truth blocks; no leak-rate claim.
T-CASE-1.note: Test conditions and tolerances, not manufacturer performance.

T-CASE-2.action: Seat comb, locate virtual mark10 mm below tooth tips, remove comb, approach fill opening, retract and reinsert comb.
T-CASE-2.observable: Tab guidance, ridge datum, mark offset and collision clearance.
T-CASE-2.pass_condition: Ten teeth retained; ridge matches short plate top within0.2 mm; mark offset10 +/-0.2 mm; nozzle path and comb motion have no unintended overlap>0.2 mm; no gel-cure success inferred.
T-CASE-2.note: Test conditions and tolerances, not manufacturer performance.
